$comment: Scales as scale degrees from the root. 'family' groups them for display; 'feel' is a short description for players. Order is the naming priority when several scales share the same notes (e.g. C major = A minor = D dorian).

types.name: major
types.feel: bright, the default for major keys

types.name: natural minor
types.feel: dark, the default for minor keys

types.name: major pentatonic
types.feel: open and safe, country and pop

types.name: blues
types.feel: minor pentatonic plus the gritty b5

types.name: major blues
types.feel: major pentatonic plus a bluesy b3

types.name: dorian
types.feel: minor with a brighter 6th, funk and jazz

types.name: mixolydian
types.feel: major with a flat 7th, for dominant chords and rock

types.name: phrygian
types.feel: dark minor with a flat 2nd, Spanish and metal

types.name: harmonic minor
types.feel: minor with a leading tone, classical and neo-classical

types.name: phrygian dominant
types.feel: the V chord of a minor key, flamenco and klezmer

types.name: mixolydian b6
types.feel: dominant with a flat 6th, for a V7 borrowed from a minor key

types.name: lydian dominant
types.feel: dominant with a raised 4th, jazz and film
